context: Tests whether an agent correctly applies the AWS Lambda OpenTelemetry platform rule across ZIP and container-image functions without inventing layer versions, mixing distributions, duplicating Collector pipeline configuration, or committing credentials.

checklist.name: ZIP and image packaging stay distinct
checklist.description: CheckoutApi remains a ZIP/SAM runtime function, while ReconcileWorker remains PackageType Image; the image function has no Layers property or layer ARN attached.

checklist.name: Backend-neutral distribution choice
checklist.description: For CheckoutApi, selects the upstream open-telemetry/opentelemetry-lambda path rather than silently enabling ADOT or CloudWatch Application Signals when no AWS-specific distribution is required.

checklist.name: No invented layer ARN
checklist.description: Does not fabricate or freeze a current OpenTelemetry layer ARN/version; models the language and Collector layer ARNs as deployment inputs/placeholders and states they must be resolved from the authoritative upstream release for eu-west-1, arm64, and the Node.js runtime.

checklist.name: Both upstream ZIP layers represented
checklist.description: The ZIP function is configured with both a runtime/language OpenTelemetry layer and the upstream Collector extension layer, without mixing them with ADOT layers.

checklist.name: Correct Node.js upstream wrapper
checklist.description: CheckoutApi sets AWS_LAMBDA_EXEC_WRAPPER to /opt/otel-handler for the upstream Node.js OpenTelemetry Lambda layer.

checklist.name: Collector configuration URI wired
checklist.description: CheckoutApi points OPENTELEMETRY_COLLECTOR_CONFIG_URI at the packaged collector.yaml file, for example /var/task/collector.yaml.

checklist.name: Stable service resource identity
checklist.description: Sets a stable OTEL_SERVICE_NAME for CheckoutApi and uses deployment.environment.name rather than the deprecated deployment.environment resource attribute.

checklist.name: Collector ownership boundary is preserved
checklist.description: The deployment wires the packaged Collector configuration URI, but does not generate or duplicate collector.yaml; it states that the separately owned Collector configuration must be authored with the otel-collector guidance and checked against the Lambda extension's supported components.

checklist.name: No committed credential
checklist.description: No output file contains a real or plausible production token, authorization secret, or plaintext ingest credential; secret-backed values remain deployment/runtime inputs.

checklist.name: Container image instrumentation guidance
checklist.description: IMAGE_FUNCTION.md explicitly explains that Lambda layers cannot be attached to PackageType Image and directs the team to package the OpenTelemetry SDK/auto-instrumentation and any required extension in the image without converting the function to ZIP.

checklist.name: Verification covers deployment risk
checklist.description: VALIDATION.md checks unchanged function behavior, expected non-duplicated telemetry, exporter/extension errors, warm execution after freeze/thaw, and cold-start or duration regression.
